sentences.translation: Jack lives with his mother in a small house.
They are poor.
They only have one cow.
The cow no longer gives milk.
The mother says, "Jack, sell the cow at the market.
“ Jack leaves early.
On the way, he meets an old man.
The man has colorful beans.
Jack exchanges the cow for the beans.
The mother is not happy.
She throws the beans out the window.
A giant tendril grows at night.
It goes all the way to the clouds.
Jack climbs up in the morning.
Upstairs is a large castle.
A friendly woman opens the door.
She gives Jack bread and soup.
Jack sees a lot of golden things.
He takes a small hen.
The hen lays a golden egg.
Jack wants to help his mother.
A giant is coming home.
He smells a human being.
Jack quickly hides.
He climbs down the vine with the hen.
There's finally food at home.
The mother laughs.
Jack says, “We have to be careful.
Jack goes upstairs one more time.
The giant wakes up.
Jack runs down the vine.
The mother fetches an axe.
She falls the tendril.
The giant remains in the clouds.
Jack and the mother share the gold.
They buy bread, fruit and warm clothes.
They pay the old debts.
The neighbors come by and congratulate.
Jack says, “We're working honestly from now on.
“ He sells eggs from the hen, but not too much.
The mother cooks soup for everyone.
Jack learns: Courage and caution can help, but honesty is important.
